description: Canonical registry of the did-usage-and-verification.md section 5.4 freshness profile ids a DID authority call site may reference. Registration fixes the id and its risk_tier; the numeric windows are declared per deployment and enter profile_policy of the section 5.3 resolver policy snapshot, so no network-wide minute count is implied.
registry_rules: freshness_profile_id values MUST be unique and MUST match ^ak\.did_freshness\.[a-z0-9_]+\.v[0-9]+$
Every DID authority call site MUST reference exactly one registered freshness_profile_id; natural-language tier guessing is forbidden

An unknown id, an unregistered action or a non-matching did_method_selector MUST be treated as the high tier with synchronous_refresh_or_fail_closed; there is no path that defaults to accepting any cached binding
risk_tier is fixed by registration. A deployment declares only the numeric windows, which MUST satisfy the tier constraints in did-usage-and-verification.md section 5.4
Adding a profile is a backward-compatible minor; changing an existing profile's risk_tier requires a new id

profiles.description: The fallback an unknown id, an unregistered action or a non-matching method selector resolves to. Registered so the fail-closed default is itself a declared row rather than an implementation constant.

The profile the identity-did.md section 3.4 high-risk authority enumeration references: recovery completion, session grant revoke lifecycle proofs, administrative risk actions and revocation approvals, organization registry bootstrap, erasure receipts and account DID binding control proofs. Never consumes a stale binding.

The profile the section 4 controller and agent-signer authority triggers reference: controller proof verification and agent key pairing resolve the same controller DID repeatedly across one interactive approval flow. Separate from ak.did_freshness.authority_high_risk.v1 so a deployment can declare a wider window for it without widening the high-risk enumeration; the new verification method trigger is served by the verification_method-keyed store entry and by explicit invalidation, not by the clock.
